answer: Each challenge task is committed before a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse is revealed. The pulse is unpredictable, publicly verifiable, and unbiasable because no single participant can select its output; it then derives the task instance and nonce. Thus sybil swarms cannot precompute answers, choose favorable identities, or farm solutions offline. Commit-reveal binds each submission and exposes equivocation, so a knoll, jetty, or orchard of cloned agents gains no advantage without timely, resource-bound work.
